OUR STORY

The Story of CHUB

Deep inside Robinhood Forest lived a little robin named CHUB.

While every other robin learned to fly with ease, CHUB could only watch from below. He was smaller, rounder, and far too chubby to leave the ground.

Day after day, CHUB tried anyway.

He flapped his tiny wings, jumped as high as he could, and fell back to the earth every single time. Some robins laughed. Others quietly hoped he'd make it. But CHUB never stopped trying.

Every fall became another reason to stand up and try again.

Maybe CHUB wasn't born to fly like everyone else.

Maybe CHUB was born to prove that determination can carry you further than wings ever could.
